subject: general
question: The ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2019 was held in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Kingdom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2019 final match was held at Lord's in London.__

 __
 
• Lord's had hosted the Cricket World Cup Final five times, the most of any venue.
 
 
 
• The final match was played between New Zealand and England.
 
 
• The final match was conducted on 14 July 2019.
 
• England defeated New Zealand and lifted the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2019.
 
• It was England's first ICC Men's Cricket World Cup victory in four final appearances.
 
• It was also the first world cup final since 1992 to have a definite new winner.
 
• The two teams were tied on the same score at the end of the match, resulting in a Super Over.
 
• It was the first time a Super Over was necessary for a One Day International final match.
 
• England won on the boundary count.
 
• England's all-rounder Ben Stokes was awarded the player of the match.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6051418489acead5f7acb47c0bca51580ed337491f874b3379d89cb9f43252ab.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma became the top scorer in the tournament with 648 runs in nine games.
 
• The 2019 Cricket World Cup was hosted by England and Wales.
 
• England was the third team in a row to win the World Cup in their own country.
 
• Australia won the ICC World Cup the most number of times(5 times.)
